annotation.title_clean: Ghana Launches National AI Strategy to Drive Digital Transformation and Economic Growth
annotation.title_en: Ghana Launches National AI Strategy to Drive Digital Transformation and Economic Growth
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Ghana
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations website (moc.gov.gh)
annotation.summary_en: Ministry news post on the 24 April 2026 launch of Ghana's National AI Strategy by President Mahama. It reports speeches stressing human-centred, ethical, inclusive AI adoption, data protection, skills development, localisation to Ghanaian languages, and the aim of making Ghana a West African AI hub. There is no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy launched 24 April 2026 to make Ghana an AI hub in West Africa
Anchored on ethical AI, data governance, infrastructure and workforce readiness
Implementation through NITA, Data Protection Commission and Cyber Security Authority with GIZ, UNDP, UNESCO
Government to augment rather than replace workers; One Million Coders programme
Parliament pledges forward-looking AI legislation; AI localised to Ghanaian languages
